bull_case: Adobe sustains >$10B TTM OCF, low capex and shrinking shares while absorbing ~45% of OCF into R&D+capex, giving both internal reinvestment and per-share compounding capacity.
bear_case: AI spend may be defensive rather than high-return; Firefly unit economics and true incremental ROIC are not disclosed, so high cash generation does not prove future reinvestment returns.
thesis: Cash generation and per-share economics are strong, but direct incremental ROIC remains unmeasured. From cutoff-valid filings/releases, TTM OCF is estimated at $10.806B, R&D $4.694B and capex $214M. The rubric-defined TTM reinvestment absorption is 45.4%, mapping to 80. TTM owner-style FCF after capex and SBC is about $8.52B (~$21.44/share on the frozen 397.5M share reference), while Q3 diluted shares fell ~6.8% y/y.

evidence.claim: TTM OCF is estimated at $10.806B from FY2025 OCF plus FY2026 nine-month OCF less FY2025 nine-month OCF.
TTM R&D is estimated at $4.694B and TTM capex at $214M; (R&D+capex)/OCF = ~45.4%.
TTM SBC is estimated at $2.071B; owner-style FCF after capex and SBC is ~$8.521B, or ~$21.44/share using frozen 397.5M shares.
Q3 diluted shares used for EPS were 395M versus 424M a year earlier, a decline of ~6.8%.

counterevidence: The filings do not disclose Firefly-specific inference margin or a direct incremental-ROIC series.
R&D growth can be defensive if generative AI erodes application-layer pricing power.
Large buybacks create per-share growth but are not equivalent to internal high-ROIC reinvestment.
unknowns: Firefly-specific contribution margin and incremental ROIC.
Maintenance versus growth components of capex/R&D cannot be separated as facts.
falsifiers: TTM owner-style FCF/share declines for multiple periods after adjusting for SBC.
R&D absorption rises while OCF and ARR growth structurally weaken.
Diluted shares stop shrinking despite continued large repurchase cash outlays.

hard_veto_flags.rationale: No structural collapse is evidenced; consolidated cash returns remain high even though AI-specific incremental ROIC is unknown.
Q3 diluted shares used for EPS declined from 424M to 395M y/y.

next_checks: FY2026 10-K for full-year R&D, OCF, capex and SBC.
Any Firefly contribution-margin or inference-cost disclosure.
Recompute TTM absorption and owner-style FCF/share at Q4.

subscores.rationale: 75 anchor: high margins, OCF and low physical capex support excellent returns; 85+ is not used because direct incremental ROIC on AI investment is not observable.
Rubric TTM metric: (capex $0.214B + R&D $4.694B) / OCF $10.806B = 45.4%. This sits in the 35–60% band near its centre; band-centre interpolation rounds to 80.

90 anchor: TTM OCF, low capex, quantified SBC and ~6.8% y/y diluted-share decline jointly support strong per-share compounding; the strongest counterpoint is that buybacks do not prove AI reinvestment returns.

uncertainties.rationale: Strong consolidated cash returns support quality, but direct incremental ROIC on current AI investment is not disclosed.
TTM absorption is mechanically observable at ~45.4%; return quality of the absorbed spend remains uncertain.
Owner-style FCF and share shrinkage are strong; SBC remains economically material.
